title: Ask the AI to read a URL

entries.text: Drop a URL, the AI reads it for you

Paste any public URL into the AI prompt bar with a question and the AI reads the page for you, then writes what you asked for into your doc with a link back to the page. Useful for articles, docs, RFC drafts, anything public on the open web. Private network addresses are refused.

entries.caption: Click into the AI prompt bar
The bar lifts and glows, ready for the URL + question.
Paste the URL with a question
Your prompt is ready, the URL tells the AI which page to read.
The AI is working, it reads the page, then the summary lands in the doc.
The AI read the page and wrote the summary into the doc, with a link to the source so the reader can verify.
